sources.title: kdkyum/two-hop-gpt-hits · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Small GPT-NeoX models trained from scratch on synthetic family documents (c5_m16_N90: 16 first names, 90 families) to study two-hop (kinship) reasoning, kept here because their held-out two-hop accuracy (eval_acc/two_hop) reached 0.99 at some eval: the 7 such runs of the d768 sweep (lr 1e-4, 1024-token rows, decay on every parameter, wd 1/3/5, seeds 41-43, loss on every token or on the answer ...

sources.snippet: two-hop-gpt-wsd-nh4 Small GPT-NeoX models trained from scratch on synthetic family documents (c5_m16_N90: 16 first names, 90 families) to study two-hop (kinship) reasoning. Every run keeps a checkpoint every 10K steps.
